title: Arena Kiosk System — Nova Backend (Sign-in, PC Booking, Locks, Analytics)
overview: The most complex subsystem in Nova. Powers two physical arena rooms: a PC/Island room (kiosk-1) and a console room (kiosk-2), plus the staff-facing 'Arena Staff' dashboard (arena.html). Combines live GGLeap PC status, guest sign-in, PC reservation/locking automation, anti-spam guarding, student profiles/incident reports, and rich analytics.

servers_and_startup.single_instance_guard: run.py calls _ensure_single_instance(port) which auto-kills any other run.py process on the same port before starting — prevents the #1 cause of login/session bugs (two servers fighting over port 5000)
servers_and_startup.no_hot_reload: Production does NOT auto-reload templates or app.py — the server MUST be restarted after every code/template edit
servers_and_startup.restart_pattern: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='python.exe'" | ? {$_.CommandLine -like '*run.py*'} | % {taskkill /F /PID $_.ProcessId}; then relaunch python run.py --production

kiosk_picker.does: Grid of available kiosks; hides admin-only kiosks from non-admins

kiosk_device_page.auth: public (admin-only kiosks check _is_full_access_user() and redirect to /login if needed)
kiosk_device_page.does: kid normalization via _arena_normalize_kid ('1'->'kiosk-1'); renders arena_kiosk1.html if kiosk type=='pc' else arena_kiosk2.html; 404 for unknown kiosk id

kiosk_templates_and_routes.arena_kiosk1.html: PC/Island room kiosk — full attract/booking/lock flow (see below)
kiosk_templates_and_routes.arena_kiosk2.html: Console room kiosk — simpler visiting/play flow, no PC picker

staff_dashboard.type: client-rendered SPA-ish page with tabs, JS wrapped in an IIFE, handlers exposed via Object.assign(window,...)

multi_kiosk_architecture.note: Kiosks are NOT hardcoded to just 2 — the system supports N kiosks, each with a type
multi_kiosk_architecture.kiosk_type: 'pc' (GGLeap PC station picker, uses arena_kiosk1.html) or 'console' (simple visiting/play, uses arena_kiosk2.html)

admin_add_remove.does: Creates a new kiosk id kiosk-N (max existing id + 1)
Blocks deleting the last remaining kiosk

multi_kiosk_architecture.nova_ui: arena.html Kiosk Manager 'Add Kiosk' modal (room/label/type), per-kiosk editor row with Open/Type-dropdown/Delete

kiosk_boot_sequence.note: The 'guard' (Guided Access) step was REMOVED after Purdue switched from iPads to laptops (2026-08-22) — laptops rely on the trap (fullscreen + beforeunload) instead of iOS Guided Access
kiosk_boot_sequence.engageTrap: Sets window._kioskTrapped=true, disables page-unload navigation, shows a bottom trap-pill (admin mode only), requests wakeLock + fullscreen
kiosk_boot_sequence.releaseTrap: Only reachable via Admin Panel 'Release Kiosk' button (passcode-gated, default 1234), shows a green 'released' overlay, allows reload
kiosk_boot_sequence.reload_skip: sessionStorage['kioskSessionArmed']='1' set at boot completion — on a same-session reload the kiosk silently re-arms without replaying the full boot animation (resumeAfterReload())

pc_availability_and_ggleap.shared_raw_cache: _ggleap_get_machines(max_age, force) — ONE cache used by every consumer (status endpoint, lock-loop, lock-status endpoint) to avoid hammering GGLeap's ~10,000 calls/day limit. This was a critical fix after a 429 outage in Aug 2026 caused by TWO independent polling loops.
pc_availability_and_ggleap.adaptive_ttl: 15s while arena is open, 120s while closed (~2,800 calls/day baseline)
pc_availability_and_ggleap.stale_on_error: Serves the last-good cached machine list on 429/timeout so kiosks never flash '0 machines'

usage_meter.tracks: per-UTC-day call counter by kind (auth/get-all/set-lock/games), persisted to data/ggleap_usage.json, limit 10000/day, shown as a progress bar in Nova Kiosk Manager

pause_switch.effect: When true, ALL GGLeap calls short-circuit (zero API usage) — read live from config, no restart needed

public_endpoint.returns: {available, in_use, offline, total, pcs:[{uuid,name,status,area,state,user_uuid,has_guest,locked}], stage:[...varsity-only, excluded from guest picker...], error, last_updated}
public_endpoint.stage_exclusion: Regex-matched 'Stage' machines are excluded entirely from pcs/counts (varsity-only, never shown to guests)

pc_reservation_hold_system.model: Kiosk-side in-memory hold only (NOT a GGLeap booking) — availability is driven by GGLeap login state (UserLoggedIn=occupied), so play time is UNLIMITED and frees automatically on logout

endpoint.does: Re-validates machine still available, checks email domain + sign-in guard, sets a hold, records a signin (reason='PC Session — <machine>'), unlocks the PC if pc_lock_enabled

pc_reservation_hold_system.history_note: A real GGLeap booking (15-min-aligned Otp code) flow was built, tested, then fully removed in favor of this simpler kiosk-side hold + screen-lock automation because GGLeap bookings couldn't lock instantly (15-min slot alignment) and had no clean unlock-after-cancel path.

pc_screen_lock_automation.config_key: pc_lock_enabled (default false) — toggle in Nova 'PC Screen Locks' card
pc_screen_lock_automation.message_shown_when_locked: 'Must be checked in on Kiosk to use system'
pc_screen_lock_automation.background_loop: _reconcile_pc_locks(), runs every 12s in a dedicated thread
pc_screen_lock_automation.logic_summary: Locks every idle+unlocked Island PC on power-on/idle. NEVER re-locks a PC a HUMAN (worker or Nova 'Unlock all') manually unlocked, until that PC reboots. A kiosk check-in unlock is tracked separately and DOES re-lock automatically if the guest never logs in (no-show) once the hold expires.
state_sets: _pc_kiosk_unlocked (guest checked in — re-lock only if hold lapses with no login)
pc_screen_lock_automation.rate_limiting: _ggleap_throttle_write() serializes all set-screen-lock calls 4.5s apart to avoid GGLeap's write rate limit (a full 24-PC room lock takes ~1.5-2 minutes)
pc_screen_lock_automation.known_platform_limitation: GGLeap has NO clean 'unlock after applied lock' API for a normal (non-admin-desktop) session — Admin Mode unlock exposes an admin desktop (security risk, avoided). A worker manually unlocking via the GGLeap dashboard is the only clean path once a lock has been applied and needs releasing outside the automation's own logic.

nova_controls.ui: arena.html 'PC Screen Locks' card: toggle, live status pills, 'Lock idle PCs now' / 'Unlock all PCs' buttons, hold-minutes field

sign_in_protection_anti_spam.watchlist_key: watchlist [{email, mode: ban|watch, reason, added_by, added_at}] — NOW STORED IN arena.db (Fernet-encrypted), NOT in JSON, since 2026-08-10 PII hardening pass
sign_in_protection_anti_spam.always_applied: ban/watch checks run regardless of the numeric guards being enabled
sign_in_protection_anti_spam.numeric_guards_default_safe: cooldown_minutes=0 (off), max_per_day=0 (off), max_active_pc=1 (on) — an earlier default of cooldown 15/maxday 8 accidentally BLOCKED legitimate re-entries and had to be reset

endpoints.returns: recent flags (used for live toasts + sound alerts on the Live Feed)

sign_in_protection_anti_spam.flags_storage: signin_flags table in arena.db (encrypted PII), capped 200 rows
sign_in_protection_anti_spam.live_feed_alerts: arena.html shows a persistent, dismissible flag banner + plays a distinct layered Web-Audio tone (3-note bell for ban, 2-note rising for watch) on new high/med severity flags

sign_in_data_model.storage: SQLite arena.db (data/arena.db) via web/arena_db.py — NOT a JSON file. Migrated off arena_signins.json in Aug 2026.
sign_in_data_model.encryption: PII fields (name, first/last, email) Fernet-encrypted at rest using the SAME key as roster PII (data/.roster_encrypt_key). Non-PII fields (kiosk, room, reason, checked_in_by, times, flags) stored plaintext for indexing.
sign_in_data_model.duplicate_checkins_allowed: Both kiosk and manual sign-in ALWAYS create a fresh record (no de-dup) — a person can check in multiple times per day and each shows as its own Live Feed card

manual_checkin.captures: reason (<=200 chars) + checked_in_by (staff display name), bypasses hours/domain restrictions

sign_in_data_model.retention: Live feed = today only (resets at local midnight, or when 'Clear Live Feed' is used — cfg.live_cleared_at); 30-day full history retention

per_day_hours_and_announcements.day_hours_key: day_hours = 7 objects (JS weekday 0=Sun..6=Sat) {open:bool, start:'HH:MM', end:'HH:MM'} — replaces legacy single open_hour/close_hour
helpers: _arena_hours_summary (grouped weekly string e.g. 'Mon–Fri 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM · Sat–Sun Closed')
_arena_schedule(cfg) (7-day list for the closed-screen schedule panel)

announcement_bar.kiosk_element: #annBar / #annText, marquee or static, pushes topbar down when shown

endpoint.returns: totals(total,unique,avg_per_day,busiest_day,peak_hour,peak_slot,busiest_weekday,accept_rate), by_day/by_hour/by_weekday/by_kiosk, heatmap(7x24)+heatmap_max, top_visitors(8), trend(vs prior period), new_returning

export.format: openpyxl XLSX, 6 sheets: Overview, Daily, Hourly, Entries, Visitors, Heatmap (day×hour ColorScaleRule)

activity_analytics.ui: Chart.js charts (daily line, hourly bar, weekday bar, new-vs-returning doughnut, kiosk doughnut) + CSS traffic heatmap grid + top-visitors leaderboard

data_layer_arena_db.student_notes: id, email_hash, email_enc, name_enc, note_enc, note_type(general|behavior|warning|positive), author, created_at
data_layer_arena_db.incident_reports: id, title, type, severity, status, involved_hash, involved_name_enc, involved_email_enc, description_enc, author, created_at, resolved_at, resolved_by

endpoints.returns: full profile: visits, notes, incidents, flags, status

removed_experimental_feature.name: Digital Signage / 'Signature Configure'
removed_experimental_feature.what_it_was: An admin-configurable slideshow/announcement screen for two 75in arena TVs (weather, live PC counts, event slides, announcements). Backend routes (/signage/*, /api/signage/*), two templates (signage_configure.html, signage_display.html), and a base.html nav link were all built, briefly tested with live data, then completely deleted at the user's request before being polished.
removed_experimental_feature.lesson: If a similar signage feature is requested again in the future, confirm scope carefully before building — this exact feature was built once already and fully scrapped.
